name: Axel
preBattleText: Three regions and you're still chasing me! Let's end this properly.
postBattleText: Always the best… Fine. I'll keep pushing. You inspire me.

name: Shella
preBattleText: The sea welcomes strong trainers. Let's find out if you qualify!
postBattleText: The tides sing your name. Welcome to Hoenn — here is the tide badge.

name: Gurath
preBattleText: Power honed in the desert heat! Try to match it!

name: Elektra
preBattleText: My volt creatures are the pinnacle of electric power! Shocking!
postBattleText: You weathered the storm. The spark badge is yours.

name: Embrik
preBattleText: The peak burns with my fire! It melts everything — including resolve!
postBattleText: Hot-blooded and skilled. Blaze badge granted.

name: Winona
preBattleText: I rule the skies of Hoenn! Can you reach me?
postBattleText: You soared to my level. Sky badge is yours.

name: Normis
preBattleText: Balance — that's the key to mastery. My balanced team will prove it!
postBattleText: Perfectly balanced. Balance badge is yours.

name: Psylara
preBattleText: In the Shadowrift, psychic power peaks. Your thoughts are transparent to me!
postBattleText: A mind I could not read. The rift badge is yours.

name: Draven
preBattleText: My dragons are perfection itself. Can your team stand before that truth?
postBattleText: The tempest bows to you. Final Hoenn gym badge — the storm badge — is yours.

name: Sidra
preBattleText: The murk welcomes you to your end. Turn back while you still can.

name: Glace
preBattleText: Absolute zero awaits you. I have never lost here.
postBattleText: Even ice shatters before true will. Move on.

name: Draveth2
preBattleText: We meet again, Johto gym beaten by your hands. Here I am at full power!
postBattleText: The mightiest dragon bows. You are worthy. Advance.

name: Auris
preBattleText: Mind and steel — the ultimate combination. This battle ends here.
postBattleText: An indomitable spirit. The Grand Master awaits.

name: Grand Master Kael
preBattleText: Three regions. Every badge. You have walked further than any trainer before. Now prove it was worth the journey.
postBattleText: I yield. You are the first trainer to master all three regions. The Stormspire throne belongs to you — Grand Champion of the World!

name: Ace Trainer Vex
preBattleText: Only the best compete in Hoenn!
postBattleText: Impressive. You truly are the best.
